title: WoW Forever Hub — Source-Verified World of Warcraft Guide
description: Source-verified information site for World of Warcraft: Forever (the repository dates Blizzard's launch to 4 November 2026 with raids unlocking 9 December 2026), published as fourteen static pages — index, roadmap, pvp, classes, class-pvp, gear, gold, addons, beta, sources, method, data-api, site-patterns and work-plan. Every published statement is carried in a claims ledger (data/claims.js; the repository counts 183 claims today, IDs deliberately not contiguous) with an evidence class of official, press, datamine, guide, ours, unknown or community, backed by a source registry in data/sources.js, and checked in CI by tools/check-ledger.mjs and tools/check-sources.mjs. Class tier lists, Best-in-Slot item lists and gold-per-hour figures are deliberately omitted because the beta is capped at level 20 (30 later) and items are hidden until they drop.
lastUpdatedField: lastCommit (newest committer timestamp on the default branch; the public API exposes no site-visit or last-use date)
flags: The repository records its own irregularity log I-1 through I-24 on method.html, and states plainly what it refuses to publish rather than filling gaps with estimates.

Grew from nine to fourteen pages between the 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-20 audits (class-pvp, addons, beta, data-api and site-patterns added) and its ledger grew from C001-C110 to 183 claims, so its totals remain a point-in-time read printed on its home page from the data files.
verifiedBasis: Re-stamped at commit f7c83bc after 1 commit, verified benign rather than assumed so. The compare 329826c...f7c83bc touches exactly two files — tools/feed-state.json (+23/-37) and tools/source-state.json (+627/-499) — in a commit titled 'chore(source-watch): update source fingerprints and feed observations'. These are the source-watch tool's own observation state, not site content: no page, no claim and no ledger row changed. The description's two countable assertions were nevertheless re-counted against this commit rather than carried on faith: the repository publishes 14 static pages plus 404.html (ls *.html returns 15 files, of which 404.html is the Pages fallback), and data/claims.js holds 183 claim entries counted by matching the id field, matching the description's 'counts 183 claims today, IDs deliberately not contiguous' — the file's own header comment instructs readers to report the claim count and never the highest ID. Reproduce: git clone https://github.com/buffedlizard55-lab/WoWForever.git && grep -cE "id: *.C[0-9]+" data/claims.js.
